NewsArticle.Title: System Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content:
Internet Maintenance
2001/07/31 1 p.m. - 5 p.m. PST
Internet Service Provider (ISP) maintenance interrupts service (including the game and web site) for up to 30 minutes any time between 1 p.m. and 5 p.m. Hours after this maintenance you will probably experience a slow connection to the game.
If you notice internet latency while playing, do not risk death. Character losses due to internet latency are not restored.
The game servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection](http://www1.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
